paper_title: The Evolution of Darija Open Dataset Introducing Version 2
caption: Distribution of Content Types in the DODa
model_annotation: This chart represents the distribution of content types in the Darija Open Dataset, showing 7 categories. The categories are: Moroccan Names (displayed in red), Semantic Categories (purple), Syntactic Roles (brown), Translated Sentences (yellow), Extra + Augmented Data (blue), Pending Translations (green), and an unlabeled slice (orange). The exact percentages are not shown, but approximate proportions can be estimated as follows: Moroccan Names (less than 1%), Semantic Categories (less than 1%), Syntactic Roles (approximately 18%), Translated Sentences (approximately 36%), Extra + Augmented Data (approximately 24%), Pending Translations (approximately 34%), and the unlabeled slice (less than 1%). The chart includes a legend and displays numerical values for some slices. The slices are not ordered in a specific way, and there is no visual emphasis on any slice.
